from datetime import datetime
import re
now=datetime.now()
year=now.year
print('now:',now,'year:',year)
# login file_system
user_email='chrharrison@gmail.com'
fs_password='-k$qjIu'
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username=user_email, password=fs_password)['access_token']
# list all cable files
cable_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/cable', recursive=True, entry_type='files')
print('cable_files:',cable_files)
# filter for this year
pattern=re.compile(r'/cable/(\d{4})-')
year_files=[]
for f in cable_files:
    m=pattern.search(f)
    if m and int(m.group(1))==year:
        year_files.append(f)
print('year_files:',year_files)
# parse totals
sum_total=0.0
line_items=[]
for f in sorted(year_files):
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=f, access_token=access_token)['content']
    # find 'Total Amount =>'
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\n', content)
    if not m:
        # sometimes format may differ; try without newline
        m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError('Could not parse total from '+f)
    total=float(m.group(1))
    line_items.append((f,total))
    sum_total+=total
print('line_items:',line_items)
print('sum_total:',sum_total)
